o1:
Enables RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity.  
Involved in establishment or maintenance of epithelial cell apical/basal polarity; positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; vulval development; and vulval cell differentiation.  
Is located in nucleus.  
Is expressed in epithelial cell; germ line; gonad; hypodermis; and somatic gonad precursor.
